feeds.title: Susanne Rieker Blog
feeds.description: Susanne is a business coach with 20+ years' experience in digital marketing, teaching yoga teachers & wellness entrepreneurs how to build a 6-figure online business. She is all about straight talk, good wine, and helping you find your superpower. Learn how to build a successful online business and monetize your passion.

feeds.title: Mastering The Business Of Yoga Blog
feeds.description: Amanda is the host & founder here at M.B.Om. She is a 500-hour RYT, a business graduate, a podcast host, and a world traveler. She came to yoga from a marketing & business background, and after completing her 200-hour yoga teacher training in Canggu, Bali in 2015, she combined her love of business with her love of teaching yoga by starting Mastering the Business of Yoga, a podcast, and online business that helps yoga teachers create businesses that they love. This blog focuses on the yoga business, yoga lifestyle, and yoga resources.

feeds.title: Pixality Design Blog
feeds.description: Pixality is ready to help you thrive in the digital space. Having worked exclusively with clients in the fitness and wellness industry, they know what works - and what doesn't - to help you reach your goals and elevate your clients' online experience. Articles, videos, and training about how to get attention online, set your business apart from the rest and get new people to check out your studio.

feeds.title: Ashes Yoga Blog
feeds.description: Ashley is an online yoga teacher and business coach and she helps other yoga teachers transform into confident online entrepreneurs. With a background in marketing & graphic design, she has learned to combine her skills (technology) with her passion (yoga) to help yoga teachers navigate the world of online yoga teaching and business building. The blog offers articles on yoga business from home, business resources, marketing, power yoga, and more.

feeds.title: Pretzel Prose Blog » Business Tips
feeds.description: Want to learn more about how you can grow your kid's yoga business? Find the latest posts here.Pretzel Kids is a one-stop shop offering yoga, mindfulness, and social-emotional learning (SEL) programs for schools and organizations, mindful movement classes, teacher certification, and a vibrant community of skilled children's yoga instructors.

feeds.title: Gwen Ferreira Blog
feeds.description: Gwen is a yoga business coach for teachers who want to turn their passion into profit. They are here to serve their clients and students and facilitate the incredible transformation yoga has to offer. Check out the blog for articles on yoga, business marketing, business models, and more.

feeds.title: The Connected Yoga Teacher
feeds.description: The Connected Yoga Teacher offers a place where you, the yoga entrepreneur, can feel supported every week, between the classes, workshops, and trainings that you are teaching or attending. Their articles are created by way of thorough research and interviews to give you the best quality, targeted information with topics specifically chosen to help grow your yoga business.

feeds.title: Yogapreneur Collective Blog
feeds.description: Josh Biro is the founder of The Yogapreneur Collective, and head coach at Nomad Business Coaching, a consulting company that helps yoga studio owners systematize their businesses for more profit and peace of mind. Read more about how to grow, market, staff, and more with these blog posts from Josh Biro, yoga business coach.
